beats.say: Harry Kane won the Men's Ballon d'Or.
It was his first time receiving the award.
The ceremony was held at the London Palladium.
According to the BBC, Alexia Putellas also made history.
She won the Women's Ballon d'Or for the third time.
Thierry Henry defended his hosting role in the BBC article.
Two major trophies went to players defining their era.
